en.title: AML 14.2.3(b) refers to the staff training rule AML 14.1.1(b)
en.summary: AML 14.2.3 deals with Group entities, but (b) requires the firm to document "the basis for its satisfaction that the requirement in AML 14.1.1.(b) is met" — the rule on training the firm's own employees. The intended target is probably AML 14.2.1(b) or the equivalence test in AML 14.2.2.
en.correction: Please confirm which requirement AML 14.2.3(b) is meant to refer to (group application, equivalence or additional measures) and correct the reference.
